neutral_facts.value: The accused and the victim were relatives who had a dispute over land. The incident occurred on 20.05.2011, involving a minor issue regarding the tying of bullocks. The accused objected to the action, leading to an altercation. The accused and the victim later settled their dispute through a compromise deed dated 29.01.2024, wherein both parties agreed to maintain peace and harmony. The compromise was supported by affidavits from the victim's side, including the uncle of the accused, who agreed to compound the offence. The trial court convicted the accused under Sections 323, 324, and 325 of the IPC read with Section 34. The High Court upheld the conviction. The Supreme Court, however, set aside the conviction under its constitutional power under Article 142, considering the nature of the incident, the relationship between the parties, and the compromise agreement.
